title: Katya Adler: France's government under pressure after widespread violence
description: Political tension grips France after rioting marred protests over the cost of living and struggling public services, Katya Adler writes.

title: Companies exploiting welfare system by using residents as 'cash cows', BBC finds
description: Agents try to attract people on housing benefit by using social media videos that offer free rooms and holidays.

title: Russian saboteur working for Ukraine shares reconnaissance videos
description: In a BBC World Service documentary, the man claims to have played a role in drone attacks on his home soil.

title: Inside the shadowy world of anti-Putin sabotage from within Russia
description: Two men tell of the work they say they have been doing to support Ukrainian intelligence during the war.

title: Watch: Chicago's battle against the synthetic drugs flooding the US
description: The BBC's Quentin Sommerville reports from Chicago, where communities are battling a new wave of synthetic drugs.

title: Home sellers cut asking prices on 3,000 properties a day
description: More property asking prices are being cut than at any time in 15 years, data shared with the BBC shows.

title: Cindy Crawford 'beyond heartbroken' after death of son Presley at 27
description: Presley Gerber's death in September is being investigated as a suspected overdose.

title: Burnham says youth employment and training crisis is a 'moral failure'
description: The UK faces "economic catastrophe" with one million young people not in work or training, the prime minister says.

title: People playing loud music on buses could face £100 fine
description:
Antisocial behaviour on buses in England could lead to fines while a new campaign is also being launched for trains.
A national campaign asking rail passengers "share the carriage, not the noise" is being launched.
